player_prompt.intro:
Ati Player {player_id} ta'a Connect Four keessatti.
Albamiin kee mallattoo: {symbol}.
Bordii tapha {num_rows} safuu fi {num_cols} kolomii qaba.
Taphattoonni marsaa gara garaa albamiin isaanii kolomii tokko (0 hamma {end_col}) keessatti galchu.
Kan jalqaba afur albamiin isaa waliin qabsiisuun (ol ka'uu, irra caaluu, ykn korbuu) moo'ata.
Marsaa keessan, lakkoofsa kolomii keessatti sarara adda addaa galchuun tapha keessan godhadha.
Fakkeenyaaf: '[col 4]' ykn '[col 1]'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Player {player_id}, Aktioni kuush. Foormaatiin daldalaa: '[col x]'.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Player {player_id}, Aktioni kuush. Koolummii {col} bahaa jirtu.

action.dropped_disk: Player {player_id} diiskii isaanii ({player_symbol}) koolummii {col} keessa galchite.
